title: Rama prepares to leave for Ayodhya
introduction: Rama prepares to leave for Ayodhya. Even though Vibhishana requests Rama to remain at Lanka for some more time and receive his hospitality, Rama gently refuses to do so, adding that he needs to proceed to Ayodhya quickly, to see his mothers, brothers and people there. Vibhishana arranges the aerial car, Pushpaka to transport Rama and others to Ayodhya.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकविंशत्यधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 121st chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तां रात्रिमुषितं रामं सुखोदितमरिंदमम् |
अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं जयम् पृष्ट्वा विभीषणः
verses.iast:
tāṃ rātrimuṣitaṃ rāmaṃ sukhoditamarindamam |
abravīt prāJṇjalirvākyaṃ jayam pṛṣṭvā vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Vibhishana, wishing victory to Rama, (the destroyer of adversaries) who having reposed during the previous night and had risen fresh, spoke to him with joined palms, the following words:

glosses.meaning: who having reposed during the previous night

verses.devanagari:
स्नानानि चाङ्गारागाणि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च |
चन्दनानि च माल्यानि दिव्यानि विविधानि च
अलंकारविदश्चैता नार्यः पद्मनिभेक्षणाः |
उपस्थितास्त्वां विधिवत् स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव
verses.iast:
snānāni cāṇ^gārāgāṇi vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca |
candanāni ca mālyāni divyāni vividhāni ca
alaṅkāravidaścaitā nāryaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇāḥ |
upasthitāstvāṃ vidhivat snāpayiṣyanti rāghava
verses.translation: "These women with lotus-like eyes, who are skilled in the art of decoration, came with bathing accessories like garments, ornaments, sandal-pastes and beautiful garlands of various kinds. They will assist you in bathing O Rama!"

glosses.meaning: who are skilled in the art of decoration
and beautiful garlands of various kinds
they will duly assist you in bathing

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम् |
हरीन् सुग्रीवमुख्यांस्त्वं स्नानेनोपनिमन्त्रय
verses.iast:
evamuktastu kākutsthaḥ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam |
harīn sugrīvamukhyāṃstvaṃ snānenopanimantraya
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Vibhishana, Rama replied as follows: "You invite the monkeys headed by Sugreeva for the bath."

verses.devanagari:
सत् उ ताम्यति धर्मात्मा मम हेतोः सुखोचितः |
सुकुमारो महाबाहुर्भरतः सत्यसंस्रयः
verses.iast:
sat u tāmyati dharmātmā mama hetoḥ sukhocitaḥ |
sukumāro mahābāhurbharataḥ satyasaṃsrayaḥ
verses.translation: "That Bharata, the virtuous man, who was accustomed to comfort, a delicate youth, the great-armed and the one consistent with the truth is suffering on my account."

glosses.meaning: and the one consistent with the Truth

verses.devanagari:
तं विना कैकयीपुत्रम् भरतं धर्मचारिणम् |
न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्यानि च
verses.iast:
taṃ vinā kaikayīputram bharataṃ dharmacāriṇam |
na me snānaṃ bahumataṃ vastrāṇyāni ca
verses.translation: In the absence of Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, who is practicing virtue, ritual bathing, garments and jewels are not to my liking."

glosses.meaning: In the absence of that Bharata

verses.devanagari:
एतत् पश्य यथा क्षिप्रं प्रतिगच्छाम ताम् पुरीम् |
अयोध्याम् गच्छतो ह्येष पन्थाह् परमदुर्गमः
verses.iast:
etat paśya yathā kṣipraṃ pratigacchāma tām purīm |
ayodhyām gacchato hyeṣa panthāh paramadurgamaḥ
verses.translation: "See how we may return to that City of Ayodhya soon. It is indeed very difficult to travel over this path to reach Ayodhya City, so soon."

glosses.meaning: is indeed very difficult to be travelled over

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः |
अह्ना त्वां प्रापयिष्यामि ताम् पुरीं पार्थिवात्मज
verses.iast:
evamuktastu kākutsthaṃ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
ahnā tvāṃ prāpayiṣyāmi tām purīṃ pārthivātmaja
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, Vibhishana replied : "O prince! I will get you t that City in a day."

verses.devanagari:
पुष्पकं नाम भद्रं ते विमानं सूर्यसम्निभम् |
मम भ्रातुः कुबेरस्य रावणेन बलीयसा
हृतं निर्जित्य सम्ग्रामे कामगं दिव्यमुत्तमम् |
त्वदर्थं पालितं चेदं तिष्ठत्यतुलविक्रम
verses.iast:
puṣpakaṃ nāma bhadraṃ te vimānaṃ sūryasamnibham |
mama bhrātuḥ kuberasya rāvaṇena balīyasā
hṛtaṃ nirjitya samgrāme kāmagaṃ divyamuttamam |
tvadarthaṃ pālitaṃ cedaṃ tiṣṭhatyatulavikrama
verses.translation: "O Rama of unequalled prowess! The aerial car shining like the sun, which moves as one pleases, wonderful and excellent, named Pushpaka of Kubera my brother was robbed by the mighty Ravana after conquering Kubera in battle. May prosperity attend you! It is retained there for your sake."

verses.devanagari:
तदिदं मेघसंकाशं विमानमिह तिष्ठति |
येन यास्यसि यानेन त्वमयोध्यां गतज्वरः
verses.iast:
tadidaṃ meghasaṅkāśaṃ vimānamiha tiṣṭhati |
yena yāsyasi yānena tvamayodhyāṃ gatajvaraḥ
verses.translation: "The yonder aerial car, looking like a cloud, stands here and by which transport, you can reach Ayodhya without any trouble."

verses.devanagari:
अहम् ते यद्यनुग्राह्यो यदि स्मरसि मे गुणान् |
वस तावदिह प्राज्ञ यद्यस्ति मयि सौहृदम्
verses.iast:
aham te yadyanugrāhyo yadi smarasi me guṇān |
vasa tāvadiha prājJṇa yadyasti mayi sauhṛdam
verses.translation: "O sagacious prince! If I deserve to be treated with kindness by you, if you think of any virtue in me and if you think of any virtue in me and if you have any affection in me, stay here for some more time."

glosses.meaning: if I deserve to be treated with kindness
if you have any affection in me

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या भार्यया सह |
अर्चितह् सर्वकामैस्त्वं ततो राम गमिष्यसि
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā bhāryayā saha |
arcitah sarvakāmaistvaṃ tato rāma gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: "O Rama! When you have been offered with reference all the entertainments, you along with Lakshmana, your brother and Seetha your consort, shall then depart."

verses.devanagari:
प्रीतियुक्तस्य विहितां ससैन्यः ससुहृद्गणः |
सत्क्रियां राम मे तावद्गृहाण त्वं मयोद्यताम्
verses.iast:
prītiyuktasya vihitāṃ sasainyaḥ sasuhṛdgaṇaḥ |
satkriyāṃ rāma me tāvadgṛhāṇa tvaṃ mayodyatām
verses.translation: "O Rama! In the meantime, accept you, with your entire army and assemblage of friends, my hospitality which has been fixed and arranged by me, full of affection as I am."

verses.devanagari:
प्रणयाद्बहुमानाच्च सौहार्देन च राघव |
प्रसादयामि प्रेष्योऽहं न खल्वाज्ञापयामि ते
verses.iast:
praṇayādbahumānācca sauhārdena ca rāghava |
prasādayāmi preṣyo'haṃ na khalvājJṇāpayāmi te
verses.translation: "O Rama! I entreat you with affection, respect and friendship I am your servant. I am not in any way commanding you to do so."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्ततो रामह् प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम् |
रक्षसां वानराणां च सर्वेषमेव शृण्वताम्
verses.iast:
evamuktastato rāmah pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇam |
rakṣasāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣameva śṛṇvatām
verses.translation: Hearing those words, Rama replied to Vibhishana as follows, while all the demons and the monkeys present there, listened:

verses.devanagari:
पूजितोऽस्मि त्वया वीर साचिव्येन परंतप |
सर्वत्मना च चेष्टाभिः सौहार्देन परेण च
verses.iast:
pūjito'smi tvayā vīra sācivyena parantapa |
sarvatmanā ca ceṣṭābhiḥ sauhārdena pareṇa ca
verses.translation: "O destroyer of enemies! O hero! I stand honoured by you by your valued counsel, your efforts put forth with your whole soul and more so by your friendship.

verses.devanagari:
न खल्वेतन्न कुर्याम् ते वचनं राक्षसेश्वर |
तं तु मे भ्रातरं द्रष्टुम् भरतं त्वरते मनः
verses.iast:
na khalvetanna kuryām te vacanaṃ rākṣaseśvara |
taṃ tu me bhrātaraṃ draṣṭum bharataṃ tvarate manaḥ
verses.translation: "O king of demons! It is not that I am not carrying out your words. But, my heart is hastening to see that Bharata, my brother."

glosses.meaning: It is not that I am not carrying out

verses.devanagari:
मां निवर्तयितुं योऽसौ चित्रकूटमुपागतः |
शिरसा याचतो यस्य वचनम् न कृतं मया
कौसल्यां च सुमित्राम् च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम् |
गुहम् च सुहृदं चैव पौरान् जनपदैः सह
verses.iast:
māṃ nivartayituṃ yo'sau citrakūṭamupāgataḥ |
śirasā yācato yasya vacanam na kṛtaṃ mayā
kausalyāṃ ca sumitrām ca kaikeyīṃ ca yaśasvinīm |
guham ca suhṛdaṃ caiva paurān janapadaiḥ saha
verses.translation: "My heart is hastening to see that Bharata, who came all the way to Mount Chitrakuta to take me back to Ayodhya, yet whose appeal was not executed by me, even though he requested me with his head bent low and Kausalya my mother as also Sumitra and the illustrious Kaikeyi (my step-mothers) as also Guha my friend, as well as the citizens of Ayodhya and the inhabitants of the country-side."

glosses.meaning: all the way to Mount Chitrakuta
eventhough he requested me with his head bent low
as well as citizens of Ayodhya
and the inhabitants of the country-side.

verses.devanagari:
अनुजानीहि मां सौम्य पूजितोऽस्मि विभीषण |
मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः सखे त्वां चानुमानये
verses.iast:
anujānīhi māṃ saumya pūjito'smi vibhīṣaṇa |
manyurna khalu kartavyaḥ sakhe tvāṃ cānumānaye
verses.translation: "O gentle Vibhishana! Allow me to go. I am honoured. O friend! You need not be disappointed, I entreat you."

verses.devanagari:
उपस्थापय मे शीघ्रं विमानं राक्षसेश्वर |
कृतकार्यस्य मे वासह् कथम् स्यादिह संमतः
verses.iast:
upasthāpaya me śīghraṃ vimānaṃ rākṣaseśvara |
kṛtakāryasya me vāsah katham syādiha saṃmataḥ
verses.translation: "O the king of demons! Fetch the aerial car immediately. How is it advisable for my continued stay here, now that my task has been accomplished?"

glosses.meaning: that my task has been accomplished.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषनः |
विमानं सूर्यसम्काशमाजुहाव त्वरान्वितः
ततः काञ्चत्राङ्गं वैदूर्यमणिवेदिकम् |
काञ्चनं काञ्चनैर्हर्म्यैर्हेमपद्मविभूषितैः
पाण्डुराभिह् पताकाभिर्ध्वजैश्च समलंकृतम् |
काञ्चनं काञ्चनैर्हर्म्यैर्हेमपद्मविब्बूषितैः
प्रकीर्णं किङ्किणीजालैर्मुक्तामणिगवाक्षकम् |
घण्टाजालैः परिक्षिप्तम् सर्वतो मधुरस्वनम्
तं मेरुशिखराकारं निर्मितम् विश्वकर्मणा |
बृहद्बिर्भूषितं हर्म्योर्मुक्तारजतशोभितैः
तलैह् स्फटिकचित्राङ्गर्वैदूर्यैश्च वरासनैः |
महार्हस्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नं महाधनैः
verses.iast:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa rākṣasendro vibhīṣanaḥ |
vimānaṃ sūryasamkāśamājuhāva tvarānvitaḥ
tataḥ kāJṇcatrāṇ^gaṃ vaidūryamaṇivedikam |
kāJṇcanaṃ kāJṇcanairharmyairhemapadmavibhūṣitaiḥ
pāṇḍurābhih patākābhirdhvajaiśca samalaṅkṛtam |
kāJṇcanaṃ kāJṇcanairharmyairhemapadmavibbūṣitaiḥ
prakīrṇaṃ kiṇ^kiṇījālairmuktāmaṇigavākṣakam |
ghaṇṭājālaiḥ parikṣiptam sarvato madhurasvanam
taṃ meruśikharākāraṃ nirmitam viśvakarmaṇā |
bṛhadbirbhūṣitaṃ harmyormuktārajataśobhitaiḥ
talaih sphaṭikacitrāṇ^garvaidūryaiśca varāsanaiḥ |
mahārhastaraṇopetairupapannaṃ mahādhanaiḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, Vibhishana the king of demons then hastily invoked the presence of that aerial car shining like the sun, with colourful parts made of gold, with the platform made of cat's-eye gems, which was full of attics, shone like silver on all sides, decorated well with white flags and flag-staff, decked with gold and golden lotuses, graced with golden mansions, hung all over with networks of tiny bells, giving forth a melodious sound on all sides, resembling a summit of Mount Meru, built by Vishvakarma, which was graced with stately palaces decked with pearls and silver, provided with pavements inlaid with crystal, furnished with excellent seats of cat's eye gems of great value and upholstered with highly valuable coverings.

glosses.meaning: with colourful parts made of gold
with platform made of cat's-eye gems
shone like silver on all sides
with net works of tiny bells
resembling a summit of Mount Meru

verses.devanagari:
उपस्थितमनाधृष्यं तद्विमानं मनोजवम् |
निवेदयित्वा रामायतस्थौ तत्र विभीषणः
verses.iast:
upasthitamanādhṛṣyaṃ tadvimānaṃ manojavam |
nivedayitvā rāmāyatasthau tatra vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Informing Rama that the said aerial car which could not be assailed and was as swift as though- had arrived, Vibhishana stood there.

verses.devanagari:
तत्पुष्पकम् कामगमं विमान |
मुपस्थितम् भूधरसंनिकाशम् |
दृष्ट्वा तदा विस्मयमाजगाम |
रामः ससौमित्रिरुदारस्त्त्वः
verses.iast:
tatpuṣpakam kāmagamaṃ vimāna |
mupasthitam bhūdharasaṃnikāśam |
dṛṣṭvā tadā vismayamājagāma |
rāmaḥ sasaumitrirudārasttvaḥ
verses.translation: The generous minded Rama along with Lakshmana felt amazed to see the aforesaid aerial car, Pushpaka, which resembled a mountain and which could travel everywhere at will, arrived on that occasion.

glosses.meaning: and which could travel everywhere at will
